alertitem.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alertitem.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alertitem.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks.
alertitem.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

alertitem.name: Re-examine Cache-control Directives
alertitem.desc: The cache-control directives were examined and found to be incorrect or missing.
alertitem.solution: For secure content, ensure the cache-control HTTP header is set with "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate".
